name: Short Squeeze Green
hook: Ride the monster green candle elevator as leveraged short sellers get vaporized
tagline: A towering pixelated green candlestick blasts through ceiling tiles like a missile, sending frantic bear avatars tumbling into margin call flames. As the multiplier spikes, liquidation sirens howl and shorts scramble to delete their prediction tweets. Cash out to lock in the green candle pump and drink champagne, or crash when a giant red wick snuffs out the ascent.
